description: Run Playwright-driven E2E/UI testing against the deployed CloudFront site (preferred) or, if deploy was blocked, against a local `npm run dev` frontend pointed at the deployed ApiUrl. Exercise the full non-chat flow that does not depend on Bedrock model access: hatch (幼年期/egg), お世話 actions (feed/train/sleep/clean), stats panel updates, battle, and 進化 (evolution banner) where reachable. Capture screenshots as artifacts. Document every real UI bug found with a concrete repro, then fix the bugs. Depends on FEAT-102 for a reachable site/API (if FEAT-102 is blocked, use local dev server against ApiUrl, or against a local mock if API also unreachable).
steps: Decide target: if FEAT-102 produced a CloudFrontUrl, test against it. Otherwise run `cd packages/frontend && echo VITE_API_BASE_URL=<ApiUrl> > .env.local && npm run dev` and test http://localhost:5173 (or the vite-reported port).
Use the Playwright Kiro Power (browser automation). If browsers are not installed, run `npx playwright install chromium` first (network is open).

Load the app. Verify the egg/幼年期 sprite renders, Japanese UI labels are present, and no console errors / failed network requests on load (check that /config.json resolves and api base url is correct).
Exercise お世話: click feed (餌やり), train (トレーニング), sleep (睡眠) toggle, clean (清掃). After each, assert the StatsPanel reflects the change and no error banner appears. Capture a screenshot per state.
Trigger battle (バトル) and verify the battle log + result render and HP updates. Capture screenshot.

Verify evolution: either wait/drive enough training+time for an evolution, or confirm the EvolutionBanner wiring renders when stageId changes (document whether reachable within test; evolution age thresholds are minutes-scale).
If chat is attempted and fails due to Bedrock AccessDenied, record it as the known environmental blocker from FEAT-102; do not treat it as a UI bug.

For every genuine UI bug (broken layout, dead button, console error, failed fetch, wrong label, a11y break), write a concrete repro + root cause, then implement the fix in packages/frontend. Re-run Playwright to confirm the fix.
Record a list of (a) bugs found, (b) which were fixed and how, (c) screenshots/artifact paths into findings.
Commit UI fixes on branch `fix/ui-playwright` (one commit per logical bug fix). Re-run `npm run build` to confirm still green. Do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: Playwright successfully loads the app and drives feed/train/sleep/clean + battle without unexpected console errors
Screenshots captured for key states (hatch, after-care, battle, and evolution if reached)
Every real UI bug found is documented with repro + root cause in findings and fixed in packages/frontend, with a passing Playwright re-run
`npm run build` still exits 0 after fixes; UI fix commits on branch fix/ui-playwright (not pushed)
Any Bedrock-dependent failure is attributed to the FEAT-102 environmental blocker, not logged as a UI bug
verification: Playwright run against CloudFrontUrl (or local dev) completing the care+battle flow

Fix re-verified locally by building the frontend and serving packages/frontend/dist via a static node server (serve.mjs) with a config.json pointing at the deployed API (local re-verification path, since the dev-server guard blocks `npm run dev`; backend untouched so CloudFront behavior is unchanged).
findings.e2e_summary: Playwright (chromium headless, driven by .agents/tasks/task-digital-monster/e2e.mjs) ran the full flow against live CloudFront: 15/15 checks PASS. Load (h1 デジタルモンスター育成, 幼年期 egg sprite SVG renders, all JP labels お世話/餌やり/トレーニング/睡眠/清掃/バトル/会話 present), feed (no error), train x3 (trainingCount 0->3), sleep toggle (睡眠->起こす, mood すやすや睡眠中), clean (no error), battle (勝利！, 4-line log, HP 20->18), evolution (reached 成長期 and EvolutionBanner seen within ~75s after the 1-min age gate + 15s tick), chat on rookie (sent こんにちは、げんき？ and a Japanese Haiku reply rendered).

bugs_found.title: Battle log rendered raw English developer strings in a Japanese UI
bugs_found.repro: Open the site, click バトル (⚔️ 野生のモンスターと戦う). The battle log lists lines like 'T1: でじたん hits 野生の幼年期モンスター for 11 (enemy HP 7)', 'T1: ... hits でじたん for 2 (player HP 18)', and 'Result: player' verbatim. See artifacts/06-after-battle.png.
bugs_found.root_cause: simulateBattle in packages/shared/src/battle.ts emits English log strings (T{n}:/hits/for/enemy HP/player HP/Result:). The backend battle Lambda returns that log as-is, and packages/frontend/src/components/BattlePanel.tsx printed each line verbatim. The winner HEADLINE was localized (winnerLabel) but the per-turn log underneath was untranslated English, inconsistent with the otherwise fully-Japanese UI (a 'wrong/missing Japanese label' defect).

fixes.how: Added pure, unit-testable helpers to packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts: winnerLabelJa(winner), battleLogLineJa(line) and battleLogJa(log). They parse the deterministic structured log format with regexes and render Japanese ('1ターン目: {attacker} の攻撃！ {defender} に {dmg} ダメージ（相手/自分の残りHP {hp}）' and '結果: 勝利！/敗北…/引き分け'); unrecognized lines pass through unchanged so nothing is dropped. BattlePanel.tsx now uses winnerLabelJa + battleLogLineJa (removed its local English-only winnerLabel). Frontend-only change: the backend/shared log format is untouched, so NO redeploy was required.
fixes.verification: 6 new node:test unit tests added to game-ui.test.ts (12/12 pass). Full monorepo `npm run build` exits 0; root `npm test` 42/42 pass. Playwright re-run against the freshly-built bundle (verify-battle.mjs, served locally against the deployed API) shows the log fully localized: e.g. '1ターン目: でじたん の攻撃！ 野生の幼年期モンスター に 3 ダメージ（相手の残りHP 15）' ... '結果: 勝利！ 🎉'. See artifacts/09-battle-localized.png. No raw English tokens remain except the standard game term 'HP' inside '残りHP' (consistent with the HP/攻撃/防御 labels used elsewhere in StatsPanel).

non_bugs: Console/network '404 GET /monster/{id}' on first load is EXPECTED: a new browser UUID has no saved monster, api.getMonster treats 404 as null and the app hatches + saves a baby egg (useMonster.ts). Handled gracefully, no error banner. Not a UI bug.
feed showing mood ごきげん->ごきげん is expected on a fresh low-hunger monster; feed still succeeded (no error, autosaved).

In headless screenshots Japanese glyphs render as tofu boxes because the sandbox browser lacks CJK fonts; this is a capture-environment artifact only. DOM textContent assertions confirmed the correct Japanese strings are present. Real users with system CJK fonts see the text correctly.
Chat works at all tiers per FEAT-105; no Bedrock AccessDenied observed this session. No Bedrock issue treated as a UI bug.
findings.evolution_chat_reachability: Evolution to 成長期 (rookie) is reachable within the test window: gate is trainingCount>=2 AND age>=1min. After 3 trainings, the monster evolved to 成長期 and the EvolutionBanner appeared once the 15s live tick crossed the 1-min age gate (~75s). Chat is reachable at rookie: a Japanese message produced a Japanese Haiku-tier reply. Baby stage correctly shows the disabled-chat hint (chat-disabled-hint) with no input.
